baseUrl.description: Required for Bitbucket Server or Data Center.

username.description: Atlassian account email for Bitbucket Cloud (not the Bitbucket username).

workspace.description: Optional Bitbucket Cloud workspace slug from bitbucket.org/<workspace>. Empty discovers all workspaces in the account.

token.description: Bitbucket-scoped Atlassian API token for Cloud, or Personal Access Token for Server/Data Center. Cloud scopes: read:user:bitbucket, read:workspace:bitbucket, read:repository:bitbucket, read:pullrequest:bitbucket.
